# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively monitor and patch security vulnerabilities. The following versions are currently supported:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v0.1.x  | :white_check_mark: |
| < v0.1  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this project, please do **not** open a public issue. Instead, help us protect the community by disclosing it responsibly.

Please send vulnerability reports to the repository owner or maintainer team. When reporting, please provide:
1. A clear description of the vulnerability.
2. Steps, script, or proof of concept (PoC) to reproduce the vulnerability.
3. The potential impact of the issue.

Email: thanh.vantrung2005@gmail.com

We will review your report, acknowledge receipt within 48 hours, and work with you to coordinate a secure resolution and release window.
